one_line: A merchant-guild patron from the Satavahana Deccan, funding rock-cut monasteries and trade routes between c. 1st century BCE–3rd century CE.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s to early 30s, medium height, lean but well-fed merchant’s build, with a composed bearing suggesting both travel and account-keeping.
appearance.face: Oval face with warm medium-brown Deccan complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed mustache, faint stubble on chin, expressive almond-shaped eyes with a calm but alert gaze, default expression a gentle confident half-smile as if negotiating a donation or trade deal.
appearance.hair: Black hair oiled and combed back into a small topknot at the crown, sides smooth and tidy, with a narrow cream-coloured cotton headband tied at the back; no turban, just the simple headband and subtle center part at the front.
appearance.costume: He wears a knee-length off‑white cotton uttariya (upper cloth) draped over the left shoulder and under the right arm in a practical merchant’s wrap, paired with a deep-ochre knee-length cotton dhoti tightly pleated in front and knotted at the waist, its border edged with a thin dark‑red stripe; around his torso is a simple narrow chest strap of brown leather holding a small document pouch at his right side, and he is adorned with modest but clear signs of prosperity: a single thin gold necklace close to the neck, two plain gold bangles on his right wrist, and small round gold stud earrings; his feet wear brown leather sandals with toe loops, and a plain cotton money pouch hangs at his left hip from a cord tucked into the dhoti knot.
appearance.signature: A rectangular wooden ledger tablet held in his left hand, with one corner wrapped in a faded red cloth and a stylus tucked under the binding cord, and in his right hand a small cloth bag heavy with Satavahana lead and copper coins whose rounded outlines show through the fabric.

ref_desc: A medium-brown Deccan merchant in his early 30s with an oval face, small topknot and cream headband, wearing an off‑white draped upper cloth and deep-ochre bordered dhoti, gold studs and bangles, brown sandals, carrying a red-cloth-wrapped wooden ledger tablet and a coin pouch in a palette of off‑white, deep ochre, dark red, brown leather and gold.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a Satavahana-era Deccan merchant-guild donor: a medium-brown man in his early 30s with an oval face, calm half-smile, neat mustache, almond eyes, and black hair oiled back into a small topknot with a cream cotton headband. Show him from head to toe in an off‑white cotton upper cloth draped over his left shoulder and under his right arm, and a deep-ochre knee-length dhoti tightly pleated in front, its hem edged with a thin dark-red stripe; add a narrow brown leather chest strap across his torso supporting a small document pouch at his right side, gold stud earrings, a single thin gold necklace, and two plain gold bangles on his right wrist. Put simple brown leather sandals on his feet and a plain cotton money pouch hanging from a cord at his left hip. In his left hand he holds a rectangular wooden ledger tablet with one corner wrapped in faded red cloth and a stylus tucked under its binding cord, while his right hand lightly grips a small cloth bag visibly filled with coins. Use a restrained palette of off‑white, deep ochre, dark red, brown leather and gold, and present him front, side, and back in consistent anime proportions, emphasizing historically plausible Satavahana merchant clothing and accessories without any modern or fantasy elements.
